answer: Every answer must pass a verifiable delay puzzle whose difficulty scales with the submitter's reputation score. Fresh accounts with no horizon history face a 15-minute computation before their answer is even visible to graders, while established peers with a clean island record skip the wait. An attacker flooding the network with bots pays the full delay cost per account and cannot parallelize across knoll because the puzzle binds to the agent's unique on-chain identity, making mass sybil attacks orders of magnitude slower than honest mining.
